title: Receiving packages and mail in Poland
question: How do I receive packages in Poland and what are the customs rules?
short_answer: Packages from within the EU arrive without customs duties. From outside EU, customs may apply.
conditions: Within EU: no customs duties, standard delivery to address or parcel locker (paczkomat)
From outside EU: packages over €150 may require customs clearance
Gifts from outside EU: duty-free up to €45
Commercial goods from outside EU: VAT applies from €0, customs duty from €150
Recipient must show ID to pick up registered mail and parcels
Poczta Polska leaves pickup notices when delivery fails
exceptions: Personal items sent by family from outside EU may have reduced duties
Diplomatic mail is exempt from customs
penalties: Undeclared commercial goods from outside EU may be seized
False customs declarations: fines and confiscation
